mechanism.claim: When the correlation minimum-spanning tree of six liquid alt returns newly becomes unusually hub-dominated, crypto price discovery has concentrated in one dynamically selected alt rather than a diffuse common mode. During elevated BTC variation, follow the unique hub's completed final-hour direction for eight elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the unique MST hub alt's final-hour return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVCMMI measures PC1 eigenvalue share and an eigenvector projection; alt leadership rotation selects the largest endpoint return; lag-transfer consensus fits directed betas. HVAMST constructs a deterministic Kruskal tree from pairwise correlation distances, ranks degree centralization, and takes direction only from the unique graph hub. It reuses no event set or control and uses no BTC direction, volume, flow, funding, OI, premium, fitted outcome, or post-entry data.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed BTC variation must occupy its causal upper 35 percent and MST degree centralization its causal upper quartile
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: 05:05/13:05/21:05 UTC graph-centralization onsets are absent from Gross9 clocks

features.aligned_window: 96 exact epoch-aligned five-minute bars from 480 unique coherent bars_binance one-minute rows [D-8h,D) for BTC and six alts
features.alt_return: log(five-minute close/open), 96 observations per alt; each sample variance strict positive
features.correlation: six-by-six float64 sample Pearson correlation matrix, finite with unit diagonal
features.distance: sqrt(max(0,2*(1-correlation))) for each unordered alt pair
features.mst: Kruskal algorithm over edges ordered by (distance, frozen first symbol index, frozen second symbol index); union-find without nondeterministic tie handling; exactly five edges
features.unique_hub: exactly one alt has strict maximum MST degree; ties reject
features.degree_centralization: sum over six nodes of (hub_degree-node_degree) divided by 20, the six-node star maximum; finite in [0,1]
features.centralization_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.hub_final_hour_return: sum final 12 five-minute returns of unique hub, finite strict nonzero
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared 96 BTC five-minute returns), finite strict positive
features.onset: eligible now and immediately preceding scheduled source-valid decision ineligible; missing or invalid prior cannot trigger

clock.side: sign of unique MST hub final-hour return
clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval and final

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent graph-topological concentration mechanism selected from formula-absence and complete-source audit only

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no universe, aggregation, correlation, distance, tree algorithm, tie rule, hub, centralization, history, rank, threshold, variation, onset, direction, clock, hold, subset, source, or control repair
